items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: I went on one of these interviews by radio, and oddly enough it was a snow storm, just like today. But I’m there and there’s Phil Schaap.

ctx.x: I know, I’ll never get through it.
